## Workflow Quick Guide
1. Add issue details and reviewer feedback in comments.
2. Add label `ready-for-implementation-plan`.
3. Review the generated plan and open questions.
4. If you answer questions or change requirements, comment `/replan`.
5. When plan is ready, add label `ready-for-ai-coding`.

## Label Reference
- `ready-for-implementation-plan` -> generates implementation plan comment.
- `implementation-plan-ready-for-review` -> plan is ready for review.
- `ready-for-ai-coding` -> generates code, pushes feature branch, opens/updates PR.
